Computational text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 73 matching passages shared between this poem and 24 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Notably, the text is virtually identical to an earlier poem bearing the same title, the *Ghatamaṇḍadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 428), sharing segments §0.2–12.1 at a similarity score of 0.99 [DharmaNexus]. Portions of its verses (§0.3–6.3) are also shared with the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meet the threshold score of 10 in the DharmaNexus corpus [DharmaNexus].
